# cassandra_role (Resource)

Manages a Cassandra role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cassandra_role" "app" {
  name     = "app_user"
  password = var.app_password # 40 to 512 characters
}

# Keep the password out of state (Terraform 1.11+). Bump
# password_wo_version to apply a new password_wo.
resource "cassandra_role" "app_wo" {
  name                = "app_user_wo"
  password_wo         = var.app_password
  password_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role, 1 to 256 characters with no double quotes.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `login` (Boolean) Allow the role to log in. Defaults to `true`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the role when using Cassandra internal authentication, 40 to 512 characters. Stored in state; use `password_wo` to keep it out. Exactly one of `password` and `password_wo` must be set.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only alternative to `password`, never stored in state, 40 to 512 characters. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.
- `password_wo_version` (String) Change this value to update `password_wo`, Terraform cannot detect changes to write-only attributes.
- `super_user` (Boolean) Allow the role to create and manage other roles. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Timeouts for role operations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Name of the role.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `default` (String) How long to retry a password change that Cassandra throttles, as a duration such as `30s` or `2m`. Defaults to `1m`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cassandra_role.app app_user
```
